schema.input: one PIL.Image.Image (any mode, converted to RGB) plus one task prompt from TASKS; the tasks in TASKS_WITH_TEXT additionally require a caption string as text_input
schema.num_beams: positive int; the snapshot's generation_config default is NUM_BEAMS=3 and decoding is deterministic beam search (do_sample=False)
schema.preprocessing: image converted to RGB; the processor resizes it to exactly 768x768 (bicubic, ImageNet mean/std), so aspect ratio is not preserved and nothing is cropped; region outputs are mapped back to input pixel coordinates. The prompt sent to the model is the task token followed by text_input when the task takes one.
